name: notify
description: A build monitor with one side effect. notify sends a message about a build and takes 300 ms; it is an effect, so a newer update of the same build never cuts a message that is being sent, and a crash is recorded as unknown, not as a failure. The producer reconciles an unknown by injecting the build id into the source `reconcile`.

neurons.description: Where build updates enter. The producer tags each with the replaces key `build`.
Sends one message about a build (appends its id to the file named by SENT_LOG) and answers with the id.
Keeps the answer of notify; says nothing.
Where the producer asks whether an unknown message was sent, with the build id in the payload.
Reads the file named by SENT_LOG and answers whether the build id is in it.
